newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest cuts many airline stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NatWest cuts many airline stocks.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities analyst Susan Donofrio said she downgraded several U.S. airline stocks due to a weakening revenue picture.
-- said has a taken a more neutral view on the airline group.

-- said downgraded Delta Air Lines Inc to hold from buy and cut both AMR Corp and UAL Corp to hold from accumulate. Said maintained an accumulate rating on Southwest Airlines Co and maintained a hold rating on USAir Group Inc.

-- said year-over-year earnings growth will likely become more difficult over the next couple of quarters for the airline sector. Donofrio cited the imminent reimplementation of the 10 percent passenger excise tax and AMR Corp's aggressive price cuts after President Clinton intervened to thwart a strike by American's pilots.
-- said USAir and UAL Corp's United Airlines will be the most exposed to American's fare actions.
-- said Southwest Airlines' recent fare increases seem to be holding. This should offset American's fare discounting.
